items.Sentence: Pond systems shall have sufficient capacity to accommodate wastewater, design seasonal precipitation, ancillary I/I, and wind driven waves.
Sludge and solid waste shall be removed from screens, sumps, tanks, and ponds as needed to ensure optimal plant operation.
Treatment and storage of sludge shall be confined to the wastewater system property, and shall be conducted in a manner that precludes infiltration of waste constituents into soil...
Land Application and/or Recycled Water Systems... Wastewater shall not be applied to an LAA within 24 hours of forecasted precipitation with a greater than 50-percent probability of occurring...
If storm water is allowed to runoff from an LAA... all applied wastewater shall meet disinfection requirements at a level equivalent to disinfected secondary-23 recycled water.
Use and disposal of biosolids shall comply with the USEPA Part 503 Biosolids Rule.
